title: run-checks
responsibility: Defines the broad verification order and the named parts CI runs side by side, plans the whole check or one part, and runs each named package script with elapsed-time reporting, stopping at the first nonzero status.

inputs.name: runSteps.steps
inputs.description: The step names to process in the supplied order; each is run sequentially and processing stops at the first nonzero result. An empty list returns 0 without invoking run.

inputs.name: runSteps.run
inputs.description: The callback invoked once for each step name, in order, and expected to resolve to that step's numeric status. A thrown error or rejection is converted to status 1.

inputs.name: runSteps.report
inputs.description: The reporter receives a start line and a completion line with elapsed milliseconds for each attempted step. Defaults to console.log; a thrown reporter error rejects runSteps.

inputs.name: planCheck.args
inputs.description: The command-line arguments. A leading --part and a name in checkParts selects that part; otherwise every step in checkSteps is planned. The remaining arguments are appended to check:game only.

outputs.name: checkSteps
outputs.description: The fixed list of broad-check script names exported by the module, in the declared order. Without --part the CLI passes all 24 names to runSteps sequentially.

outputs.name: runSteps
outputs.description: Resolves to 0 when every supplied step succeeds, or to the first nonzero status and stops there. A thrown report callback rejects the promise.

outputs.name: checkParts
outputs.description: The CI parts by name. Each lists its steps in checkSteps order and, for a slice of test:e2e, its vitest shard. Together they include every step.

outputs.name: planCheck
outputs.type: { steps: readonly string[]; command(step: string): string[] }
outputs.description: The steps to run in order, and a function giving the bun arguments for a step, including the test:e2e shard of a sharded part.

errors.name: Check runner callback or launcher failure
errors.description: A throw from report is uncaught and rejects runSteps; throws or rejections from run are caught and converted to status 1.

errors.name: Unknown check part
errors.description: planCheck throws when --part has no name or a name that checkParts does not define, so a mistyped part never passes without running anything.
